newsitem.title: JAPAN: LDP says Japan to keep option of extra budget-Jiji.
newsitem.headline: LDP says Japan to keep option of extra budget-Jiji.

text.p: The option of implementing fiscal stimulus steps such as an extra budget will not be ruled out in a fiscal reform law, which the Japanese government plans to draw up by the end of June, a key official of the ruling Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) was quoted as saying by Jiji news service on Thursday.

"We will be cautious in handling fiscal stimulus steps, but we will make sure in the fiscal reform law that emergency fiscal measures necessary for economic management are possible," Jiji quoted Taku Yamasaki, chairman of the LDP's policy research council, as saying.
Jiji said Yamasaki made the remarks at a meeting with a construction industry group.

But Yamasaki later told reporters that, in principle, steps to stimulate the economy should be carried out through structural reform and that fiscal measures were to be taken in case the economy worsened drastically, Jiji said.
